description: Queue NIPR renewals for up to 500 ready licensees as one batch. authorized_by_name and authorized_by_email must name the person who approved paying state fees up to fee_cap_cents per renewal; ask them first, never invent them. A renewal whose fee is above the cap pauses at needs_input. Never send SSNs, FEINs or other tax ids, dates of birth, passwords (NIPR or any other), card or bank numbers: the API refuses them, and you must not ask the user for them. Sandbox (the default) files and charges nothing. Servicing: needs an API key.

fee_cap_cents.description: Most authorized per renewal, in cents

report_emails.description: Owner or admin emails for the batch report; all of them when absent

scenario.description: Sandbox only: the outcome to simulate

name: licensing_queue_renewals
title: Queue license renewals
